All shippable items are shipped by dimensional weight. Dimensional weight is calculated by the carrier based on the amount of cubic space an item requires for transport, and may be higher than the actual item weight.
Shipping:
All items are typically shipped within five business days (Monday through Friday, excluding major holidays) following the date of purchase. We do NOT offer any shipping options faster than FedEx Ground.
Please contact us prior to making payment if there are specific shipping requirements or requests such as signature confirmation or insurance.
Additional charges may apply.
We do not, under any circumstances, accept pre-paid shipping labels provided by customers.
Please contact us with any questions or concerns regarding shipping prior to paying.
Combined Shipping:
Items eligible for combined shipping may be combined at the time of payment. If an item is already paid for, it may not be combined with an unpaid item.
Local pickup
is available on
select items only
, and will be noted on the item as "Local Pickup". Pickup items are available at the Goodwill of Colorado Springs Main Campus, located at 1460 Garden of the Gods, Colorado Springs, CO, 80907.
For qualifying pick-up orders, pickup is available by appointment only.
Delivery Not Received:
Please contact within 7 days of the expected delivery date if a package has not been delivered by the time provided by the shipping carrier. We will file a claim with the shipping carrier (typically FedEx) after that. Please do not file a claim before contacting us, FedEx requires the shipper to file them. If the item is returned to us because a signature could not be obtained, or if an item is returned to us as undeliverable/unclaimed it is the buyers responsibility to contact us within 7 days and pay the additional postage to mail it again otherwise items returned to us will be considered a donation and relisted at our discretion.
We are not responsible for packages that were delivered and stolen from property. Goodwill will not be liable and all refund requests will be denied.
Damaged Merchandise:
If merchandise has been damaged during shipping, please contact us within 7 days. Photos of packaging and item damages will be required for refund approval.

Description:
Enhance your vintage collection or utility display with this unique lot of 3 antique electrical insulators. This set includes a clear Hemingray-56 glass insulator, an amber Whitall Tatum No. 511 glass insulator (both marked Made in U.S.A.), and a brown porcelain insulator of unknown make. Each piece showcases classic industrial designwith embossed brand marks on the glass models and a time-worn patina on the porcelain. Durable and historically significant, these insulators served as essentials in early telegraph and power lines. Perfect for repurposing, educational displays, or collectors, these authentic pieces come from trusted American manufacturers and offer both nostalgia and craftsmanship. Their robust construction ensures longevity for decorative or practical reuse. All pieces are original, showing minor wear consistent with age, adding to their authenticity.

description:
A handsome pair of substantial sterling silver rings featuring mixed-metal detailing, artisan styling, and distinctive design.
The first ring features a warm gold-tone band accented by a bezel-set faceted red stone. Interior hallmarks include “STERLING,” “.925,” and “14K,” confirming precious-metal markings for both sterling silver and 14K gold. The photographed scale shows this ring at approximately 2.375 grams. The identity of the red stone has not been verified.
The second ring is a wide sterling silver band featuring dimensional geometric and leaf-like detailing with decorative beaded borders and a Southwestern-inspired appearance. The interior is visibly stamped “925,” indicating sterling silver. The photographed scale shows this ring at approximately 3.300 grams.
Together, the pair offers an attractive combination of sterling silver, mixed-metal character, gemstone styling, and handcrafted appeal. Both show signs consistent with previous wear, including surface variation and patina. Please review all photographs for hallmark, design, and condition details.
Total Photographed Weight: Approximately 5.675 grams combined.
Collector / Reseller Note:
The visible 925/STERLING and 14K hallmarks add particular interest for precious-metal jewelry buyers and resellers. The mixed-metal red-stone ring and decorative sterling band may also appeal to collectors of artisan, Southwestern-inspired, and vintage-style jewelry. Stone identity, maker, age, and origin are not confirmed.
Shipping / Pickup:
Shipping available. Small jewelry lot suitable for protective packaging. Local pickup may also be available according to auction terms.

description: This vintage mineral and rock specimen collection contains over 100 individual samples housed in two compartmentalized cardboard trays. Each specimen is labeled with its name and locality, featuring minerals such as manganite, scoria, smoky quartz, serpentine, sphalerite, malachite, obsidian, olivine, marble, pyrite, graphite, galena, garnet, dolomite, and others. The labels indicate origins from various U.S. states, including some cards from the Texas Memorial Museum in Austin, Texas. Specimens are generally small and mounted or glued on individual cards. The collection is in used condition with visible wear, stains, and possible residue from old glue. Total weight is 2.6lbs. Suitable for collectors, educators, or geology enthusiasts.

This set features the renowned Sheaffer's Lifetime 14K yellow gold nib, celebrated for its durability and smooth writing characteristics. Please contact us with any questions or concerns regarding shipping prior to paying.

is available on
select items only

Damaged Merchandise:
If merchandise has been damaged during shipping, please contact us within 7 days. Photos of packaging and item damages will be required for refund approval.

shipping.policy:
Combined Shipping Temporarily Unavailable:
Item combining is
temporarily unavailable while we transition to a new system
. During this time, orders must be shipped individually and cannot be combined for reduced shipping charges. We appreciate your patience and understanding as we complete this update. Once our new system is fully in place, combined shipping options may become available again.
Items will not be dismantled for any reason, no exceptions. Pure "Buy-It-Now" items cannot be combined per ShopGoodwill.com guidelines.
Shipping via FedEx:
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Any order with items totaling $300 or more will automatically require a signature.

Additional Information:
All items are factory sealed and include original retail packaging.

shipping.policy:
Items typically ship within 5 business days after payment is made excluding weekends & holidays.
COMBINED SHIPPING - Items eligible for combined shipping may be combined at the time of payment. If an item is already paid for, it may not be combined with an unpaid item. We will only combine up to 20lbs. We reserve the right to deny combined shipping when there is a probability for damage.
When shipping with FedEx the shipping weight shown is calculated based on a dimensional weight & will sometimes appear to be inflated but is actually used to give our customers a lower shipping rate. Please use the shipping calculator provided in each auction to determine shipping costs to your specific location.
If an item is damaged during shipping, we will need a photograph of the damage to the packaging & the item, & may need a signed statement prior to a refund being issued. In the event of damage please keep all packaging & the damaged item available until a refund is issued.

description:
Vintage Hemingray-42 Glass Electrical Insulators Aqua Blue Clear Lot
This lot includes multiple vintage Hemingray-42 glass electrical insulators primarily made in the USA. The insulators feature the classic two-tiered dome shape typical of early to mid-20th-century telegraph and power line insulators. Colors include aqua blue and clear glass finishes. Each insulator measures approximately 3.5 to 4 inches tall. The pieces show vintage used condition with internal bubbles, surface scuffing, and traces of dirt. No visible cracks or severe chips are present. These insulators are suitable for collection, industrial decor, or repurposing projects.
6 x 6 x 4 in
Details
Local Pickup is now available.
Please initiate all scheduling, inquiries and notifications via your Shopgoodwill account by selecting: Contact Us then Create a New Support ticket.
Please make sure to read description, look at all pics and ask questions prior to bidding as all sales are final.
General Conditions
All items are used, sold as found, and AS IS with no warranties expressed or implied.
We are not experts in any field; descriptions are based on our best ability using available resources.
Measurements are approximate.
Please read the description, review all images, and ask questions prior to bidding. All sales are final.
Placing a bid indicates acceptance of these terms.
Jewelry & Precious Metals
We do not have a gemologist or jeweler on staff. Items are listed to the best of our ability and have not been professionally tested or serviced.
Diamonds vs. moissanite cannot be differentiated by our equipment.
Gems are tested with a Presidium Gem Tester; however, it cannot distinguish natural vs. synthetic stones, and items may have flaws, scratches, or inclusions beyond our ability to identify.
Gold-filled items are only described as marked/stamped or by magnetic properties. Actual karat levels may vary.
Magnetic clasps may be present in precious metal jewelry due to spring mechanisms.
Jewelry testing is only performed upon request, using acid testing. Any post-purchase testing is the buyer’s responsibility, and refunds will not be issued based on authenticity disputes.
Designer items are not authenticated unless specifically stated.
Watches may not include batteries; functionality is not guaranteed.
Lot Listings
Lots may contain mixed items (e.g., jewelry, watches, coins, toys, sports/trading cards, marbles, Legos, etc.).
Items in lots may be unsorted and can include broken, dirty, tangled, or incomplete pieces. Stones, beads, or parts may be missing.
Due to volume, we cannot answer detailed questions about individual pieces within a lot.
Lots are non-refundable and cannot be combined with other purchases.
Authentication
Signatures and autographs are not authenticated unless specified.
Name brand items are not authenticated unless listed as Certified Authentic.
Certified items are authenticated through AuthenticateFirst.com and include a certificate in compliance with ShopGoodwill’s brand policy.
Electronics & Clocks
Tested only for powering on, unless otherwise stated.
Further testing is performed only if equipment is available, and results will be noted in the listing.
Items sold AS IS, with no refunds on functionality.
Shipping
FedEx is the only carrier used.
Shipping weights are calculated by dimensional weight; please check the on-screen shipping calculator before bidding.
Adjustments will only be made if they reduce shipping costs and do not exceed FedEx’s charges.
Maximum combined shipping weight is 20 lbs, per carrier restrictions.
Goodwill of Central Illinois is not responsible for items lost or stolen in transit. Please follow up directly with the carrier for claims.
Placing a bid on any item is an indication that you agree to the terms mentioned above.

Payment:
The only methods of payment we accept are Visa, Master Card, and Discover Card. We do not accept cash, checks, or any other form of payment.
Sales tax will be figured and added to each purchase based on the rate and requirement from your state.
Shipping:
Upon receipt of payment, we utilize Fedex and USPS as our primary shipping carriers. Shipments to P.O. Boxes will be shipped by USPS. We do our best to have items shipped within 7 business days from the date of payment; we are not open on weekends. We are limited to the carriers’ rules and regulations when shipping an order. Shipping charges are calculated at time of payment. Please check shipping rates prior to placing your bid. All items will be shipped as listed and will not be dismantled for any reason.
Minimum shipment weight is 1 lb. Items weighing less than 1 lb. will be calculated at the 1 lb. rate.
Please check shipping rates prior to placing your bid.
Combined Orders:
Multiple items can be combined PRIOR TO the checkout process provided that the payment deadline has not expired on any of the items that you are combining to create the order, and that the combined weight does not exceed 20 pounds. Combined shipping must be requested by the customer prior to payment; it is not automatically allowed. Once an item has been paid for, it is no longer eligible for combined shipping. We reserve the right to deny combination of certain items.
Insurance:
Buyer must email a request for insurance prior to making payment. Insurance cannot be added by the buyer during the payment process. An e-mail must be sent to us and we will then edit the order total for you.
We apologize, but if your package is damaged or lost we will not be able to issue a refund unless your package was insured. We strongly recommend insurance on all breakable items. Photos will be required before a refund will be considered.
Handling Fee:
A minimum of $3.00 handling fee will appear at checkout and applies to all purchases regardless of delivery method or pick up. Our handling fee is a set fee and cannot be adjusted. (Certain items that are very fragile, irregularly shaped, and/or heavy may be subject to an increased handling fee.) These fees, along with your purchase, help to support our Goodwill mission.

description:
A fine assortment of vintage sterling silver and artisan jewelry pieces. Highlights include a double-strand cultured pearl necklace with a turquoise drop pendant, a dark iridescent freshwater pearl necklace with an abalone shell pendant, natural coral branch bead strand, a sterling silver frog brooch, and a carved silver frog motif ring.
Assortment Includes:
Cultured Pearl Necklace: Double strand of creamy white cultured pearls featuring a filigree box clasp and a teardrop turquoise stone drop pendant.
Dark Pearl & Abalone Shell Necklace: Strand of dark peacock iridescent freshwater pearls featuring a mother-of-pearl/abalone shell pendant (stamped 925 on lobster clasp).
Coral Branch Bead Necklace: Fine liquid silver/beaded wire necklace accented with natural red coral branch chips and oxidized silver focal beads.
Sterling Silver Frog Brooch: Detailed 3D sterling silver frog pin (stamped "925" on reverse).
Sterling Silver Frog Ring: Carved sterling silver face ring with stylized frog eyes and mouth (marked inside band with copyright symbol, "92", and hallmark details).
Materials: Sterling Silver (.925), Cultured Pearls, Freshwater Pearls, Natural Coral, Turquoise, Abalone / Mother-of-Pearl
Piece Count: 5 Individual Jewelry Items (Jewelry display box included)
Condition: Excellent vintage condition. Sterling silver pieces show light natural oxidation/patina that can be polished if desired. Clasps, pin mechanism, and bead strands are secure and fully functional.

description:
Missouri Meerschaum Corncob Pipe Lot
2 Piece Set, Vintage Tobacco Smoking Pipes
Corncob, Wood, and Plastic, Approximately 6 Inches Long
A pair of vintage corncob tobacco pipes manufactured by the Missouri Meerschaum Company of Washington, Missouri. Founded in 1869, Missouri Meerschaum is the world's oldest and largest manufacturer of corncob pipes, known for their cool-smoking properties and historical significance in American culture. These two examples feature different bowl textures and stem designs, ideal for collectors or enthusiasts of traditional smoking implements.
Lot includes two distinct corncob pipes with wooden stems and amber-toned mouthpieces
One pipe retains the original factory label on the base identifying it as a Missouri Meerschaum original
Handcrafted construction utilizing natural corncob for a unique porous smoking experience
Sizes range from approximately 5.5 to 5.75 inches in total length
Condition:
Bowls show evidence of previous use with light charring visible inside the chambers. The exterior of the corncob bowls remains structurally sound with natural variations in texture. Wood stems are secure. Plastic mouthpieces are intact without significant bite marks or cracks. Base label on one pipe is present and legible with minor edge wear. Generally well-preserved vintage condition.

description:
A beautiful four-pair collection of turquoise and blue-toned earrings bringing together Southwestern silverwork, dramatic dangles, artisan-style stone accents, and bohemian movement. This is one of those lots that gives a turquoise lover several completely different looks in one collection.
Included are:
A dramatic pair of multi-strand turquoise-colored seed bead dangle earrings with silver-tone accent beads
A long pair of delicate silver-tone dangles ending in freeform turquoise-colored stone drops
A pair of blue/turquoise bead dangles finished with rounded silver-tone bead accents
A substantial pair of sterling silver teardrop-form post earrings featuring oval turquoise-colored cabochons and sculptural openwork design
The largest silver pair makes a particularly strong statement, with sweeping dimensional silver forms surrounding the blue cabochons. The remaining pairs range from earthy Southwestern to relaxed bohemian styling, making this a versatile wearable collection.
Photographs show the larger silver pair weighing approximately 15.05 g / 0.530 oz. Additional photographed pairs weigh approximately 3.77 g / 0.133 oz and 4.08 g / 0.143 oz. Length and scale are documented alongside a ruler in the photographs.
Sterling/silver content appears to vary within the grouping; bidders should rely on the detailed photographs of individual construction and any visible markings rather than assuming identical metal content across all four pairs.
A strong choice for a turquoise collector, Southwestern jewelry lover, Western wardrobe, festival/boho collection, or jewelry reseller. The variety of sizes and silhouettes also makes this an appealing lot for someone who wants both everyday turquoise and larger statement pieces.
Condition: Pre-owned estate condition with expected surface wear, oxidation/patina, and signs of previous use. Natural stones and stone-like components may show inherent variations in color, matrix, shape, and texture. Please review all photographs for backs, findings, posts, hooks, stones, and overall condition.
Shipping: Shippable. Earrings will be carefully packaged for transport.

description:
Glass Insulator Lot - 3 Pieces
Hemingray and American Manufactured
Aqua Teal and Clear, Vintage Mid-Century Era
This collection of three vintage glass insulators represents a significant era in American telecommunications history. Used primarily to insulate telegraph and telephone wires from their wooden support poles, these heavy glass pieces are prized by collectors for their industrial aesthetic and vibrant glass colors. This lot provides a balanced display including a classic aqua teal piece and two clear glass specimens.
Pieces Included:
Hemingray Insulator, Aqua Teal Glass, embossed "HEMINGRAY" with beaded drip points - minor base fleabites
Clear Glass Insulator, embossed "MADE IN U.S.A.", smooth base - excellent vintage condition
Unmarked Clear Glass Insulator, smooth base - excellent vintage condition
Condition:
The lot is in very good vintage condition. The teal Hemingray insulator shows typical minor chipping and roughness along the drip points on the base, which is characteristic of utility-grade glass. The clear insulators are notably well-preserved with no significant chips or cracks. All pieces retain their original glossy transparency without signs of glass disease or mineral cloudiness.

Combined Shipping Temporarily Unavailable:
Item combining is
temporarily unavailable while we transition to a new system
. During this time, orders must be shipped individually and cannot be combined for reduced shipping charges. We appreciate your patience and understanding as we complete this update. Once our new system is fully in place, combined shipping options may become available again.
Items will not be dismantled for any reason, no exceptions. Pure "Buy-It-Now" items cannot be combined per ShopGoodwill.com guidelines.
Shipping via FedEx:
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Any order with items totaling $300 or more will automatically require a signature.

Shipping or Delivery is available for some items at the buyer's expense.
After your item(s) are paid, you will receive a separate invoice for shipping charges. Depending on the size of the sale and amount of shipping, it may be several days after pickup before you receive your shipping invoice.
All items must be paid for before they are picked up, shipped, or delivered.
We reserve the right to request photo identification (credit card and driver's license) matching the credit card on file before shipping high value items.
SHIPPING:
We strongly recommend local pick-up. If non-local bidders are unwilling to pay shipping and handling fees, please DO NOT BID because bidding privileges will be revoked for non-payment or forfeiture. Failure to pay or pick up items will be grounds for banning bidder from all future bidding on the nationwide platform. There is no fee if you pick up your item on the pick-up dayduring the scheduled pick-up time!
Shipping is available on select items only with prior approval and at the buyer's expense. NO SHIPPING ON CHINA, FURNITURE, RUGS, OR OTHER LARGE ITEMS. Customers who desire shipping must get approval from staff and must select \"shipping\" prior to the close of the auction.
Get approval by emailing Wendy Jane,
wjane@caringtransitions.com
. If approval is not requested in advance, we reserve the right to deny shipping. If shipping is approved, please be advised of the following:
1.
SHIPPING SAINT
: Shipping is available through Shipping Saint. All shipping and handling charges will be billed through Shipping Saint. Shipping Saint uses FedEx, UPS, and USPS. All items are insured at the buyers expense. Signatures are required on delivery. Will combine lots if possible.Handling fees plus the cost of shipping supplies, packing, shipping, and insurance charges will be invoiced separately. Customers will need to approve this second invoice. Customers are charged the actual cost of shipping.
2.Please pay your original invoice, as the shipping quote will be invoiced separately via Shipping Saint. Shipping invoices may not be sent until early the following week after our actual pickup.
Please make note: shipping payment must be received by noon Friday following pick-up day or items become CTECOS property.
3.Unless items can fit into a USPS Priority box, shipping will be done via UPS or another third-party shipper deemed appropriate and/or necessary. This can be costly depending on the size and weight of lot(s) and shipping price cannot be quoted until they have the items in hand. Please bear this in mind when bidding.
4.Breakables will only be packed and shipped via third-party vendors. We do not ship china sets or furniture. Please note listings with *This lot will not be shipped* were chosen for non-shipping due to various reasons.
5.A handling fee is added to the invoice if you request shipping.This fee is based on the quantity of lots, labor, and boxes required. The handling fee applies to items dropped off at the third-party shipper as well. This DOES NOT cover the cost of shipping.
6.
All shipments will be insured.
Items will be insured for the amount of the winning bid and bidder is responsible for submitting any claims related to items damaged during shipment. Once shipment is shipped, Caring Transitions is no longer responsible for it.
Contact Wendy Jane or Judy Downing for invoice or payment issues at
wjane@caringtransitions.com
. Contact Ian Sua'ava for shipping issues at
ctecosship@gmail.com
. The contact phone number is 719-247-2169.

Customers will be responsible for paying all packing, shipping, and insurance charges. Please be aware that shipping charges can be very expensive and may even exceed the amount that you paid for the item,so please consider that when placing your bids. If shipping is not paid for, item(s) will be considered abandoned property and will be resold or donated with no refund provided. Bidder account may be suspended for failure to pay for shipping costs.
Make It Returnable and Delivery Guarantee: A Third Party Vendor, SEEL, provides MAKE IT RETURNABLE (Return Assurance) and GUARANTEED DELIVERY (Shipping Protection) services for select and eligible lots on CTBids. These services can be purchased by you during the bidding process or with your CTBids Premier Membership subscription. This purchase constitutes a direct service agreement between you and SEEL and not with any CTBids or Caring Transitions franchise. SEEL is the final authority and is solely responsible for handling claims.
https://www.seel.com
. To start a claim or check claim status, visit:
https://resolve.seel.com
. For return questions, email:
Returns@Seel.com
. Please Note: The original CTBids Buyers Premium, shipping fees, and return shipping costs to SEEL for items are not covered or eligible for reimbursement. ALL items in a lot must be returned with a claim for a customer refund. Items must be returned in the same condition as when purchased. A request to return a lot must be made within (7) SEVEN days of the delivery date or the item received date (pick-up or shipped).

description:
A versatile three-necklace jewelry collection featuring turquoise-blue accents, silver-tone details, and an appealing mix of Southwestern, bohemian, and natural-stone-inspired styling.
The focal necklace features a double-strand design with turquoise-blue heishi-style disc beads, accented by decorative silver-tone beads, small turquoise-colored elements, and creamy white elongated beads. Slender silver-tone tube sections extend toward the neckline, creating a balanced combination of color and metalwork.
A second necklace combines turquoise-colored round beads with irregular creamy white pearl-style beads and silver-tone spacers. The alternating textures and colors create an organic, artisan-inspired appearance with plenty of visual interest.
Completing the trio is a streamlined silver-tone snake-style chain necklace finished with a substantial polished turquoise-blue freeform pendant. Its minimalist presentation allows the vivid stone-look pendant to take center stage.
Stone, pearl, and metal compositions have not been confirmed. Turquoise, pearl, and heishi references describe the visible appearance and style of the pieces and should not be interpreted as authenticated materials. Makers, ages, and origins are also unconfirmed. Please review photographs for visible condition and construction.
Collector / Reseller Note:
A strong grouping for collectors, boutique sellers, and resellers of Southwestern-inspired and bohemian jewelry. The assortment offers three distinct looks: a colorful double-strand heishi-style necklace, a turquoise-and-pearl-style strand, and a minimalist turquoise pendant necklace.
Display Note:
White jewelry bust, wood slabs, driftwood, and all other photographic props are not included.
Shipping / Pickup:
Shipping available. Necklaces should be individually packaged to help prevent tangling and protect beads, pendant, and metal components. Local pickup may also be available according to auction terms.

description:
A distinctive three-ring sterling silver collection featuring figural, romantic, and sculptural designs, with visible sterling hallmarks and maker markings adding collector interest.
The first ring features a glossy black heart-shaped cabochon bezel-set in sterling silver. Dimensional bead or berry-like accents decorate the shoulders, creating an appealing combination of romantic symbolism and substantial artisan styling. The interior bears a visible “925” hallmark, indicating sterling silver.
The second ring features an unusual sculptural hand motif, with dimensional fingers wrapping across the top of the band in a striking figural design. Interior markings appear to include “925” along with initials/maker marks, though the maker cannot be confidently identified from the photograph.
The third ring showcases a flowing modernist floral or calla lily-inspired design, with sweeping dimensional forms wrapping gracefully around the finger. This piece is visibly marked “STERLING” and also bears what appears to be a “NOVICA” maker/retailer mark. The sculptural botanical form gives this ring especially strong artisan and collectible appeal.
All three rings display surface variation and patina consistent with previously worn sterling silver jewelry. The black stone composition, individual makers beyond visible markings, ages, and origins have not been independently verified. Please review all photographs for hallmarks, weight, design details, and condition.
Collector / Reseller Note:
A particularly appealing sterling grouping for collectors and resellers because each ring offers a very different design category: black heart jewelry, figural hand jewelry, and sculptural botanical/modernist jewelry. Visible sterling and maker markings further enhance identification and resale interest.
Display Note:
Wooden ring stands, black fabric holders, wood slabs, driftwood, and all other photographic props are not included.
Shipping / Pickup:
Shipping available. Rings should be individually protected during packaging to preserve the stone, sculptural details, and sterling finishes. Local pickup may also be available according to auction terms.

description:
Glass Insulator Lot - 3 Pieces
Hemingray, No. 42 Pattern
Aqua and Clear, Vintage
This collection features three vintage American glass insulators, including two in the classic aqua blue-green color and one in clear glass. These No. 42 telegraph insulators were a staple of American infrastructure throughout the mid-20th century, produced by the Hemingray Glass Company. They are highly collected for their architectural form and the way they capture and refract light in display settings.
Pieces Included:
Glass Insulator, Aqua, Hemingray No. 42, Made in U.S.A., Drip points on base - Minor edge fleabites
Glass Insulator, Aqua, Hemingray No. 42, Made in U.S.A., Drip points on base - Minor base roughness
Glass Insulator, Clear, No. 45 mark on base ring, Tapered design - Surface wear and inner haze
Condition:
Overall very good vintage condition. The aqua pieces show typical minor roughness and small fleabites on the bottom drip points, which is common for authentic used insulators. The clear piece shows some light surface scratches and internal cloudiness or residue. No large structural cracks or major damage observed. Original manufacturing bubbles and swirl marks are present within the glass, adding to the vintage character.
***Condition Disclaimer***
This is a USED item donated to Goodwill Easter Seals of the Miami Valley.
Please see images for further detail and ask any questions you may have before making a bid.

description:
Vintage-style sterling silver and turquoise jewelry grouping featuring a substantial turquoise statement ring accompanied by a pair of coordinating turquoise sterling silver earrings.
The ring features a rounded turquoise cabochon in a raised bezel surrounded by an architectural, fluted silver setting. The shoulders have bold dimensional ribbed detailing that gives the ring a classic Southwestern statement-jewelry appearance. The interior shows age-related surface wear and oxidation consistent with vintage use.
The ring measures approximately size 7½ on the photographed mandrel.
The coordinating earrings feature round turquoise cabochons with visible natural-looking matrix in smooth sterling silver settings. The reverse sides are visibly stamped “STERLING” along with additional maker/initial markings that appear to include “GIL” and “MW”; please refer to the detailed photographs for the exact marks. The earrings are fitted with post backs.
Photographed scale readings include approximately:
Ring: 0.216 oz / approximately 6.135 g
Earrings: 0.237 oz / approximately 6.740 g
The photographs also document the approximate physical dimensions of the earrings against a ruler.
Turquoise varies naturally between the pieces in tone and matrix, giving the grouping an appealing collected-over-time character. Stone identification is based on appearance and existing context; no gemological testing is represented.
Pre-owned jewelry showing patina, oxidation, scratches, tarnish, and general surface wear consistent with age and previous use. Please review all photographs carefully for exact condition, markings, sizing, stone coloration, and construction.
Collector/Reseller Note: An appealing grouping for collectors of vintage Southwestern jewelry, sterling silver, turquoise, statement rings, and wearable estate jewelry.
Shipping/Pickup:
Shippable. Jewelry will be packaged appropriately for shipment. Local pickup also available according to scheduled auction pickup terms.

shipping.policy:
Shipping Policy
Goodwill Industries of Ventura & Santa Barbara Counties is not responsible for items that are lost or stolen after the carrier confirms delivery. Items marked as delivered to the address provided become the responsibility of the buyer. Any delivery concerns must be directed to the shipping carrier.
Orders typically ship within
5 business days
after payment clears (excluding weekends and holidays).
All shipments are sent
via FedEx only
, following FedEx packaging standards.
Orders over $100 require signature confirmation upon delivery.
Combined Shipping
Items that are not eligible for combined shipping are determined, at our discretion, to pose a risk of damage if shipped together.
Requests for combined shipping must be submitted
before payment
via a customer service ticket.
Once payment is completed, orders
cannot be modified or combined
.
Buy It Now Non-Auction items and Stock Items are not eligible for combined shipping.
ART with glass is not eligible for combined shipping regardless of whether or not the system lets you combine them!
NOTE:
It is buyers' responsibility to evaluate whether or not the items could be safely combined! The system may "LET" you combine items, but should you combine a 13 LB bowling ball with a 2 LB vase?
Buyer will be responsible for damages of combined shipping items.

Vintage/Antique is based on appearance only.
Lots are Sold As Is.
This auction is a bulk sale, we are unable to provide additional information on individual items featured in this auction. We are unable to verify count or completeness of large lots. All lots are FINAL SALE. No Refunds or Returns.
About Us / Mission
Goodwill Industries of Ventura & Santa Barbara Counties provides vocational and educational opportunities that eliminate barriers to employment, strengthen communities, and help individuals reach their full potential through the power of work.
Thank you for supporting our mission.
Item Condition & Seller Disclosure (Important)
All items are
USED and donated
to Goodwill Industries of Ventura & Santa Barbara Counties.
While items are visually inspected, our staff are
not subject-matter experts
, and some defects, missing parts, or operational issues may go unnoticed. Descriptions represent our observations at the time of listing and should not be considered expert evaluations.
Please review all photos carefully.
Ask any questions
before bidding
.
By placing a bid, buyers acknowledge and accept the item’s condition as described and shown.
Electronics Testing & AS-IS Policy
Some electronic items may not be fully tested due to time constraints, lack of equipment, or item complexity. When an item is
not tested
, this will be clearly disclosed in the listing description.
Important terms:
Electronics are sold
AS-IS
unless otherwise stated.
Only the testing explicitly described in the listing has been performed.
If no testing details are mentioned,
no testing should be assumed
.
Power cords, adapters, batteries, manuals, or accessories are
not included unless specifically stated
.
Un-tested or partially tested electronics are
not eligible for refunds
.
Shipping Policy
Goodwill Industries of Ventura & Santa Barbara Counties is not responsible for items that are lost or stolen after the carrier confirms delivery. Items marked as delivered to the address provided become the responsibility of the buyer. Any delivery concerns must be directed to the shipping carrier.
Orders typically ship within
5 business days
after payment clears (excluding weekends and holidays).
All shipments are sent
via FedEx only
, following FedEx packaging standards.
Orders over $100 require signature confirmation upon delivery.
Combined Shipping
Items that are not eligible for combined shipping are determined, at our discretion, to pose a risk of damage if shipped together.
Requests for combined shipping must be submitted
before payment
via a customer service ticket.
Once payment is completed, orders
cannot be modified or combined
.
Buy It Now Non-Auction items and Stock Items are not eligible for combined shipping.
ART with glass is not eligible for combined shipping regardless of whether or not the system lets you combine them!
NOTE:
It is buyers' responsibility to evaluate whether or not the items could be safely combined! The system may "LET" you combine items, but should you combine a 13 LB bowling ball with a 2 LB vase?
Buyer will be responsible for damages of combined shipping items.
Local Pickup Policy
All items are available for local pickup.
Scheduling & Payment
Pickup appointments are
required
and must be scheduled through the Pickup Scheduler on ShopGoodwill or in the app.
All orders must be paid in full prior to pickup.
No payments are accepted at the time of pickup.
Pickup Hours
Monday–Saturday:
8:00 AM – 3:00 PM (PST)
Closed for lunch:
11:00 AM – 12:00 PM
Please arrive on time. If delayed, notify us through a customer service ticket.
Items must be picked up within
14 calendar days of payment
. Items not collected within this period are considered
abandoned & re-donated
and are relisted
without refund
.
Buyers may arrange third-party pickup or delivery for large or “Pickup Only” items. The carrier must be able to pack, load, and transport the item and assumes full responsibility. Please submit a customer service ticket for coordination.
No pets allowed
, except service animals.
Pickup Location
Goodwill Industries of Ventura & Santa Barbara Counties
Goodwill Outlet
1401 N. Rice Ave
Oxnard, CA 93030
(Entrance on Maulhardt — Check in with the Outlet Cashier)
Returns & Refunds
All items are sold
AS-IS
and are
non-refundable
, except in cases of:
Damage occurring during shipment, or
Gross misrepresentation.
All returns require
prior approval
.
Requests must be submitted within
5 days of delivery
via the customer service ticketing system.
Shipping-damage claims must include clear photos of both the item
and
original packaging.
Returns will be denied if the item has been altered, tampered with, or modified after shipment.
Authenticated Items
If this auction has been authenticated by a third-party vendor, the Title or Description may state w/COA or Authenticated however it Does NOT come with physical COA.
COA is only emailed upon request.
Items authenticated by third-party providers include a
$9.99 handling fee
.
Customer Service
Hours:
Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 3:00 PM (PST)
For assistance, submit a customer service ticket through your account or use the
Contact Seller
link on the listing.
We aim to respond within
2 business days
. Closure of a ticket indicates a response has been issued and does not necessarily indicate final resolution.

description:
Pressed Glass Insulators Set - 2 Pieces
Hemingray, Multi-Pattern
Aqua and Straw, Vintage Antique
This collection features two distinct vintage glass insulators produced by Hemingray, a primary manufacturer of American telegraph and telephone insulators during the late 19th and early 20th centuries. These pieces represent the industrial history of communication, highly valued by collectors for their varied colors, embossed markings, and heavy glass construction.
Pieces Included:
Hemingray 680 Insulator, straw/clear color, top-mount design with triple-ribbed base, embossed "HEMINGRAY - 680" on the skirt
Hemingray Signal Insulator, aqua blue glass, beehive shape, embossed "PATD NOV 13TH 1883" on the base skirt
Condition:
The aqua insulator shows standard age-related surface scuffs and minor internal bubbling consistent with period glass production; no major cracks or large chips are observed. The straw-colored 680 insulator exhibits surface cloudiness and some mineral deposits from outdoor exposure, but retains crisp embossed lettering. Both pieces are heavy and structurally sound for display.
Warehouse Location: Cleveland
Due to our lighting, white glare lines may appear on items - This is NOT damage
If you have any questions regarding the quality or authenticity of this item or general questions regarding and item, please click Contact Seller on the item page and send us a message. We are available to answer your questions Monday through Friday, 8 am - 3:00 pm, EST.
* For combined shipping policy see the shipping tab.
Some items may contain unseen flaws not noted in the description.
See Photos. Items sold as-is.

Third-Party Pick-up
At this time third party pick up is not allowed.
Puerto Rico Shipping Unavailable
We are unable to ship to Puerto Rico at this time and all orders containing a Puerto Rico shipping address will be refunded.

description:
Pair of Carolyn Pollack sterling silver earrings featuring oval faces with geometric multicolor stone inlay. The mosaic-style design incorporates turquoise-blue, green, deep blue, black and warm reddish-orange sections separated by silver-tone channels.
Each oval earring is framed by a dimensional sterling silver border with incised Southwestern-style detailing. Backs feature hinged clip-style findings as photographed.
Earrings measure approximately 1 inch across based on the photographed ruler reference. Combined weight shown is approximately 8.355 g / 0.294 oz.
Pre-owned with patina, oxidation, surface wear and finish variation. Inlay components show natural variations in coloration and pattern. Please review all photographs for maker details, measurements, construction and condition.
Shipping/Pickup: Shippable. Available for local pickup or shipping. Jewelry will be carefully packaged for transit.

This comprehensive geological collection is designed for education, display, and hands-on learning. The set features a blue-framed, multi-compartment specimen display case housing an array of small, curated mineral samples. Accompanying the display box is a detailed reference guide titled "Gemstones and Minerals of the World," which provides a color-coded identification chart for easy classification. This collection is ideal for classroom learning, hobbyist rockhounds, or young geologists exploring earth sciences.

Shipping:
Orders will ship via USPS, or FedEx services. Items may be marked as being shipped USPS but may come via FedEx and vice versa. If you want your item to be shipped a certain carrier please inform before paying for the item.
Any additional shipping instructions requested (I.E. individually wrapping items, duplicate boxes, etc) will require additional shipping charges to be paid by the customer. We will work with customers to fit their requests at the lowest possible shipping charge. Any order that totals equal to or greater than $120 will automatically require an indirect signature upon delivery. Any order that totals equal to or greater than $400 will automatically require an direct signature upon delivery. If you choose to negate this process you claim full responsibility for the delivery of the item as we provide the tracking information to you.
In the event a large item is won that is marked for local pickup only, you the buyer will have the option to have the item pick it up by a freight company at your expense.
Please note that all items ship in the order they are received and will ship within 5 business days (Excluding weekends and holidays) of the payment date.

We reserve the right to deny combination of items. Items will not be dismantled or disassembled for any reason, no exceptions.

shipping.policy:
All shippable items are shipped by dimensional weight. Dimensional weight is calculated by the carrier based on the amount of cubic space an item requires for transport, and may be higher than the actual item weight.
Shipping:
All items are typically shipped within five business days (Monday through Friday, excluding major holidays) following the date of purchase. We do NOT offer any shipping options faster than FedEx Ground.
Please contact us prior to making payment if there are specific shipping requirements or requests such as signature confirmation or insurance.
Additional charges may apply.
We do not, under any circumstances, accept pre-paid shipping labels provided by customers.
Please contact us with any questions or concerns regarding shipping prior to paying.
Combined Shipping:
Items eligible for combined shipping may be combined at the time of payment. If an item is already paid for, it may not be combined with an unpaid item.
Local pickup
is available on
select items only
, and will be noted on the item as "Local Pickup". Pickup items are available at the Goodwill of Colorado Springs Main Campus, located at 1460 Garden of the Gods, Colorado Springs, CO, 80907.
For qualifying pick-up orders, pickup is available by appointment only.
Delivery Not Received:
Please contact within 7 days of the expected delivery date if a package has not been delivered by the time provided by the shipping carrier. We will file a claim with the shipping carrier (typically FedEx) after that. Please do not file a claim before contacting us, FedEx requires the shipper to file them. If the item is returned to us because a signature could not be obtained, or if an item is returned to us as undeliverable/unclaimed it is the buyers responsibility to contact us within 7 days and pay the additional postage to mail it again otherwise items returned to us will be considered a donation and relisted at our discretion.
We are not responsible for packages that were delivered and stolen from property. Goodwill will not be liable and all refund requests will be denied.
Damaged Merchandise:
If merchandise has been damaged during shipping, please contact us within 7 days. Photos of packaging and item damages will be required for refund approval.

description:
Cross
Classic Century Pen and Pencil Set - Chrome Finish
Vintage "Couples Gift" Edition, Original Case
This vintage Cross Classic Century set showcases the iconic slim silhouette and specialized engineering that have defined the brand since the mid-20th century. Featuring the distinctive black conical tops and a polished chrome finish, this set was marketed as a "Couples Gift," presented in a dedicated two-toned green and cream clamshell case. The Classic Century remains a staple of American writing instrument design, valued for its balanced weight and reliable twist-action mechanism.
Polished chrome-plated barrels with signature black conical end caps
Set includes one twist-action ballpoint pen and one matching mechanical pencil
Original vintage presentation box with "Couples Gift" silk lining and green textured exterior
Classic slim profile designed for ergonomic comfort and professional portability
Condition:
Very good vintage condition. The chrome finish on both writing instruments is bright with only minor surface micro-scratching consistent with light handling. Twist mechanisms on both pieces are intact with no visible damage. The presentation case is structurally sound with a functional hinge; internal silk lining shows minimal age-related wear. Exterior of the case is clean with crisp branding.
***Condition Disclaimer***
This is a USED item donated to Goodwill Easter Seals of the Miami Valley.

Item combining is
temporarily unavailable while we transition to a new system

Items will not be dismantled for any reason, no exceptions. Pure "Buy-It-Now" items cannot be combined per ShopGoodwill.com guidelines.
Shipping via FedEx:
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Any order with items totaling $300 or more will automatically require a signature.

- Color Range: Purple, Clear, Black, Yellow, Green, Blue
- Weight: Approximately 5 pounds

***Please see pics***
Clear Title.

description:
Natural Specimen
Quartz Geode Crystal Cluster
Mineral on Green Host Rock Matrix
Approximately 3.5" x 2.5" x 2"
Unsigned
This striking natural geode specimen features a cavity of sparkling clear quartz crystals nestled within a vibrant, teal-green host rock matrix. The exterior coloration suggests the presence of copper-bearing minerals such as chrysocolla or malachite, providing a dramatic visual contrast to the prismatic crystalline interior. This piece serves as a sophisticated organic accent, showcasing the raw geological beauty and complex textures found in natural mineral formations.
Features a well-defined interior cavity lined with translucent quartz crystal clusters
Natural green and turquoise-toned host rock with earthy iron-oxide inclusions on the reverse
Unique asymmetrical form suitable for shelf, desk, or cabinet display
Condition:
Excellent natural condition. As a raw geological specimen, it retains its original jagged edges and characteristic surface variations. The crystal points appear well-preserved within the cavity, and the surrounding matrix is stable with minor natural surface wear typical of extracted mineral specimens.

shipping.policy:

The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a PO Box.
Orders will be shipped within

Items over $1000 will require increased insurance.

About Us / Mission
Goodwill Industries of Ventura & Santa Barbara Counties provides vocational and educational opportunities that eliminate barriers to employment, strengthen communities, and help individuals reach their full potential through the power of work.
Thank you for supporting our mission.
Item Condition & Seller Disclosure (Important)
All items are
USED and donated
to Goodwill Industries of Ventura & Santa Barbara Counties.
While items are visually inspected, our staff are
not subject-matter experts
, and some defects, missing parts, or operational issues may go unnoticed. Descriptions represent our observations at the time of listing and should not be considered expert evaluations.
Please review all photos carefully.
Ask any questions
before bidding
.
By placing a bid, buyers acknowledge and accept the item’s condition as described and shown.
Electronics Testing & AS-IS Policy
Some electronic items may not be fully tested due to time constraints, lack of equipment, or item complexity. When an item is
not tested
, this will be clearly disclosed in the listing description.
Important terms:
Electronics are sold
AS-IS
unless otherwise stated.
Only the testing explicitly described in the listing has been performed.
If no testing details are mentioned,
no testing should be assumed
.
Power cords, adapters, batteries, manuals, or accessories are
not included unless specifically stated
.
Un-tested or partially tested electronics are
not eligible for refunds
.
Shipping Policy
Goodwill Industries of Ventura & Santa Barbara Counties is not responsible for items that are lost or stolen after the carrier confirms delivery. Items marked as delivered to the address provided become the responsibility of the buyer. Any delivery concerns must be directed to the shipping carrier.
Orders typically ship within
5 business days
after payment clears (excluding weekends and holidays).
All shipments are sent
via FedEx only
, following FedEx packaging standards.
Orders over $100 require signature confirmation upon delivery.
Combined Shipping
Items that are not eligible for combined shipping are determined, at our discretion, to pose a risk of damage if shipped together.
Requests for combined shipping must be submitted
before payment
via a customer service ticket.
Once payment is completed, orders
cannot be modified or combined
.
Buy It Now Non-Auction items and Stock Items are not eligible for combined shipping.
ART with glass is not eligible for combined shipping regardless of whether or not the system lets you combine them!
NOTE:
It is buyers' responsibility to evaluate whether or not the items could be safely combined! The system may "LET" you combine items, but should you combine a 13 LB bowling ball with a 2 LB vase?
Buyer will be responsible for damages of combined shipping items.
Local Pickup Policy
All items are available for local pickup.
Scheduling & Payment
Pickup appointments are
required
and must be scheduled through the Pickup Scheduler on ShopGoodwill or in the app.
All orders must be paid in full prior to pickup.
No payments are accepted at the time of pickup.
Pickup Hours
Monday–Saturday:
8:00 AM – 3:00 PM (PST)
Closed for lunch:
11:00 AM – 12:00 PM
Please arrive on time. If delayed, notify us through a customer service ticket.
Items must be picked up within
14 calendar days of payment
. Items not collected within this period are considered
abandoned & re-donated
and are relisted
without refund
.
Buyers may arrange third-party pickup or delivery for large or “Pickup Only” items. The carrier must be able to pack, load, and transport the item and assumes full responsibility. Please submit a customer service ticket for coordination.
No pets allowed
, except service animals.
Pickup Location
Goodwill Industries of Ventura & Santa Barbara Counties
Goodwill Outlet
1401 N. Rice Ave
Oxnard, CA 93030
(Entrance on Maulhardt — Check in with the Outlet Cashier)
Returns & Refunds
All items are sold
AS-IS
and are
non-refundable
, except in cases of:
Damage occurring during shipment, or
Gross misrepresentation.
All returns require
prior approval
.
Requests must be submitted within
5 days of delivery
via the customer service ticketing system.
Shipping-damage claims must include clear photos of both the item
and
original packaging.
Returns will be denied if the item has been altered, tampered with, or modified after shipment.
Authenticated Items
If this auction has been authenticated by a third-party vendor, the Title or Description may state w/COA or Authenticated however it Does NOT come with physical COA.
COA is only emailed upon request.
Items authenticated by third-party providers include a
$9.99 handling fee
.
Customer Service
Hours:
Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 3:00 PM (PST)
For assistance, submit a customer service ticket through your account or use the
Contact Seller
link on the listing.
We aim to respond within
2 business days
. Closure of a ticket indicates a response has been issued and does not necessarily indicate final resolution.

description:
This listing includes a mixed lot of assorted tumbled and raw stones, minerals, and gemstones. The collection features a variety of colors such as green, blue, red, black, white, gray, and brown. Some stones are polished while others remain in their natural form. The stones range from small to medium size and are suitable for collecting, crafting, or educational use. Notable pieces include a blue tumbled stone, a clear quartz-like crystal, snowflake obsidian, and several colorful polished gems. The items are in used, natural condition with typical wear visible on some stones. No specific brand or model is associated with this lot.
*All measurements are approximations.
*All sales have three days from the date of delivery to report a discrepancy.
*All sales are final after three days from delivery.
Returns need to be shipped to:
Goodwill2Go
245 Deo Drive
Open Mon-Fri 9 am to 4 pm
Payments and Local Pickups: Credit card payments are only accepted online through shopgoodwill.com. Credit card payments must be made online 24 hours prior to order pickup. Items may be picked up at Goodwill2Go offices during normal business hours. Customers must notify Goodwill2Go of anyone picking up items other than the name listed on the account. Items not picked up within 30 days of auction closing will be considered a donation and no refunds will be issued unless another time frame is specified in listing.
Combined Shipping: 20 pound weight limit for all combined orders. Contact Goodwill2Go prior to the checkout process to combine shipping.
Jewelry: All jewelry is sold "As Is" without warranty or guarantee. Items have not been professionally tested or authenticated. Goodwill2Go utilizes Gem Oro Gold and Diamond Testers. Measurements are approximates. Reserve prices do not reflect an appraisal value. We offer a three-day return policy on items with a major listing discrepancy. After three days of receipt, all sales are final.
Shipping: Licking/Knox Goodwill will not be held responsible for items lost or stolen within shipping route once they have left our facility. Please follow up with the carrier for these types of situations.
Damage: Contact Goodwill2Go immediately in the event your items were damaged during shipping. Issues are resolved on a case-by-case basis.
Return Policy: Unless otherwise noted, all merchandise is sold As Is Questions regarding quality or authenticity of an item should be directed to Goodwill2Go offices prior to placing a bid.
Thank you for supporting Licking/Knox Goodwill; your patronage provides training, employment, and supportive services to individuals with disabilities and other barriers to employment. Good luck and happy bidding!

We ship exclusively via FedEx Ground/Home Delivery. *FedEx cannot deliver to P.O Boxes, APO, FPO, or DPO addresses.*
Combined Shipping:
You may combine items when:
1.) All auctions close within 7 days and
2.) All items are safe to ship in one box and
3.) All items combined do not exceed 20 lbs. (We reserve the right to deny a combination of items when necessary.)
ONCE PAID FOR, ITEMS MAY NOT BE COMBINED.
Handling charges will not be reduced.

description:
Mixed Lot Collectible Rocks Minerals Stones Quartz Petrified Wood Arrowheads
This lot contains a diverse assortment of collectible rocks, minerals, and stones. Included are small polished river stones, rough mineral specimens, petrified wood pieces, quartz crystals, and possible arrowhead artifacts. The collection features various colors including gray, black, brown, white, and tan, with textures ranging from smooth and polished to rough and crystalline. Items are in mixed condition, from raw and uncut to tumbled and smooth. No brand or manufacturer markings are present. Suitable for collectors, educational use, or crafts.

description:
Product Overview:
This collection features a variety of mineral and rock specimens along with fossilized or mineralized plant material. Included are samples with different colors such as white, black, gray, red, orange, yellow, and purple. Some mineral samples are crystalline while others are more opaque. The collection also contains elongated reddish-brown pieces resembling petrified wood or fossilized plant stems, plus a larger specimen with star-shaped patterns.

Specifications:
- Material: Mineral and rock specimens, fossilized and mineralized plant material
- Color Variations: White, black, gray, red, orange, yellow, purple
- Types: Crystalline minerals, opaque minerals, petrified wood/fossilized stems
- Weight: Approximately 5 pounds
- Condition: Natural wear and chipping consistent with geological samples

shipping.policy:
We use FedEx as our contracted shipping carrier and follow their packaging guidelines. Keep in mind, FedEx now uses a volumetric calculation to determine shipping estimates. This is called
dimensional weight
and refers to the amount of space a package occupies in relation to its actual weight. For more information regarding dimensional weight, please visit:
https://www.fedex.com/en-us/shipping/packaging/what-is-dimensional-weight.html
.
Once payment has cleared, orders are generally processed within 5 business days, not including weekends or holidays.
Goodwill Industries of the Inland Northwest will not be held liable for lost or stolen packages if they are marked
delivered
within the tracking details. It is the responsibility of the customer to contact the shipping carrier to inquire about the claims process for reimbursement. We are happy to provide the necessary paperwork to facilitate this process.
Purchased items will be shipped as specified within the order. We are unable to reroute packages once processed. Please ensure any address changes are made prior to payment during the checkout process. Per FedEx policies, we cannot accept P.O. boxes, please provide us with a physical address.
Buyers may also arrange their own third-party shipping service for pick-up only items. However, the carrier must assume all responsibility for the item and must be able to retrieve, pack, and ship. Please submit a customer service ticket for inquiry.
Combined shipping
Due to automation, items can only be combined prior to payment being received. Eligible items must meet the following criteria:
The items are from the same Goodwill location.
The items close within the same week.
You have not already paid for any of the items.
The combined weight does not exceed 20 pounds.
Items are not already in a fixed-price, flat-rate shipping box.
Items can't be purchased via buy-it-now or with 1 cent shipping.
You will be automatically prompted to combine all available items during checkout. If the site does not, please submit a customer service ticket for inquiry; some exceptions may be made.

shipping.policy:
1. Items from our selling location will ship within 5-7 business days (Excluding weekends & Holidays) from the time payment is received. We are working as fast and safely as possible to ensure all orders are shipped out in a timely manner.
2. We default ship FedEx & follow their packaging guidelines. Due to the odd dimensions of certain items, FedEx may charge more for shipping oversize items & calculate that into shipping weight as a "dimensional weight." Any special requests for alternate packaging arrangements may incur an additional handling fee charge to be paid before shipment. For more information on Dimensional Weight please visit:(http://www.fedex.com/in/tools/dimweight.html)
3. Paid for items will be shipped as specified within the order and will not be able to be modified or combined.
4. Items can only be combined prior to payment being received.
5. Items may be combined for shipping when the following criteria are present:
1. The items are from the same selling Goodwill.
2. The items close within the same week.
3. You have not already paid for any of the items.
4. The combined shipping weight does not exceed 20 pounds.
5. Items are not already in a fixed price flat rate shipping box.
6.
Can not combine Buy Now Items (due to system limitations)
6. If your auction items meet the above criteria, the site will prompt automatically to combine all available orders during the payment process. If the site does not automatically prompt please submit a customer service ticket for inquiry some exceptions may be made.
7. Goodwill Industries of Orange County will not be held responsible for items lost or stolen within shipping route once they have left our facility. Please follow up with carrier for these types of situations.
8. FedEx claims are filed on your behalf. We are not responsible for denied claims or delays on FedEx resolutions.
9. There will be a re-shipping fee for items that are returned to sender.

description:
Natural Mineral Collection
Multi-Specimen Crystal and Geode Lot
Natural Stone, Quartz, Amethyst, and Pyrite
Unsigned
This mineral and crystal collection features a diverse array of geological specimens, totaling approximately 7 pounds. The centerpiece is a substantial deep purple amethyst point with well-defined terminations and a vibrant violet hue. The lot includes unique pyrite clusters accented with decorative pewter miniatures-a prospector and a forest scene-typical of late 20th-century gift specimens. A variety of open quartz geodes, a large polished heart, and various raw specimens provide a wide range of textures and colors for the collector.
Substantial amethyst point with natural crystalline terminations
Decorative pyrite specimens featuring detailed pewter miniatures
9" x 9" x 5" overall dimensions for the complete collection

Good condition for natural minerals. Pieces exhibit minor edge wear or natural inclusions inherent to raw crystals. Polished items maintain a smooth finish with minimal surface dust present.
Warehouse Location: Cleveland
Due to our lighting, white glare lines may appear on items - This is NOT damage
If you have any questions regarding the quality or authenticity of this item or general questions regarding and item, please click Contact Seller on the item page and send us a message. We are available to answer your questions Monday through Friday, 8 am - 3:00 pm, EST.
* For combined shipping policy see the shipping tab.
Some items may contain unseen flaws not noted in the description.
See Photos. Items sold as-is.

: Natural Limestone Rock Specimen Geological Display Fossil
Color

Department
: Collectibles & Art

: Collectibles & Art
Condition

Approximate measurements (inches)
: 9L x 4W x 6.5H

Description
: Discover the charm of nature with this unique porous rock specimen, perfect for collectors or as a captivating decor accent. Its naturally weathered surface and intricate holes add organic interest, making it a fascinating conversation piece for desks or display shelves. The light gray stone, characterized by its textured, multi-dimensional appearance, evokes a sense of natural history and adventure, making it ideal for geology enthusiasts or educational purposes. Versatile in use, it can enhance terrariums, aquariums, or be a centerpiece in natural art arrangements. Carefully hand-selected and thoroughly cleaned, this stone ensures authenticity. A memorable and eco-conscious addition to any collection, it brings a piece of the outdoors into your living or workspace. Shop with confidence knowing you are purchasing a one-of-a-kind specimen.

shipping.policy:
Shipping:
Shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). Orders will be shipped within
5 business days
(Monday-Friday) of payment. However, we make every effort to ship sooner. Shipping may be delayed in the event of unforeseen business closure for holidays, disasters, etc.
Our shipping software shops for the best shipping option for your order. The carrier that the item is listed with may not be the carrier with which the item(s) ship.
Combined Shipping:
Items may be combined to save on shipping charges if the auctions close within 7 days of each other, are safe to ship in one box, and we are contacted prior to payment. Once paid for, items are no longer eligible to be combined. Once a combined shipping charge has been calculated for an order, no additional items may be added to an order.
Because of how our carriers charge for shipping, item weight is calculated based on the dimensional weight and not the actual weight of the item. This can potentially add to the shipping charge of combined orders if larger shipping materials are required.
Most of our Jewelry items are listed with a flat rate shipping fee. If you purchase more than one item, please send a Customer Service ticket through your Shopgoodwill.com account before paying so that we can remove the flat rate fee. After the flat rate fees are removed shipping cost will be calculated directly from the courier's site. Art, glass, musical instruments, prepackaged lots, heavy items, and other fragile items may not be eligible for combined shipping.
We do not ship orders to PO Boxes.
You will need a physical street address to receive your packages.
Signature Verification
: For all orders $1000 or more, packages must be signed for by an adult in the household.
Attention:
Goodwill Middle TN is not responsible for lost or stolen packages after delivery to the customer has been confirmed with tracking information. Contact FedEx or USPS for further information.

description:
Enter The Earth / Making Memories
Natural Mineral and Fossil Specimen Collection
Geology Study Lot, Late 20th to Early 21st Century
This comprehensive geological collection features a diverse array of natural mineral specimens, fossils, and hand-carved gemstones. The lot is anchored by a 18-compartment organizer containing various rough stones including rose quartz, amethyst, jasper, and apatite, accompanied by a descriptive insert regarding Coprolite (fossilized dung). Complementing the boxed set are several larger individual display pieces and professional carvings from international sources.
Polished Pyrite sphere with "Made in Peru" label featuring natural vuggy texture
Polished Orthoceras cephalopod fossil specimen in black matrix
Amethyst geode with iridescent gold-tone titanium-treated coating
Four hand-carved stone animal figurines: Kambaba, Picture Jasper (Oregon), and Tigereye (South Africa)
Clear plastic organizer box with approximately 18 varieties of rough and tumbled mineral specimens
Condition:
Very good overall condition. Mineral specimens are in their natural rough or polished states as intended. The pyrite sphere and geode are intact with no structural cracks. The carved animals are housed in original protective plastic cases; cases show minor surface scuffing but remain functional. The main organizer box is complete and latches securely, though the lid shows typical light storage wear.

shipping.policy:
We strive to package/ship all orders within 2-5 business days of payment. Our dedicated shipping department is skilled in preparing delicate items. Rest assured your order will arrive in the same condition as pictured.
We ship exclusively via FedEx Ground/Home Delivery. *FedEx cannot deliver to P.O Boxes, APO, FPO, or DPO addresses.*
Combined Shipping:
You may combine items when:
1.) All auctions close within 7 days and
2.) All items are safe to ship in one box and
3.) All items combined do not exceed 20 lbs. (We reserve the right to deny a combination of items when necessary.)
ONCE PAID FOR, ITEMS MAY NOT BE COMBINED.
Handling charges will not be reduced.

description:
Lot of 17 Assorted Polished and Rough Rock Mineral Specimens Jasper Agate
This lot includes 17 assorted polished and rough rock and mineral specimens. Types include jasper, agate, petrified wood, and other semi-precious stones. Colors vary across browns, reds, yellows, greens, and blues. Specimens range from small fragments to larger slabs. Some pieces feature unique banding and patterns with polished surfaces, while others retain rough natural textures. These used, unmounted specimens are suitable for collectors, lapidary work, display, tumbling, or further cutting and shaping. No brand or manufacturer is indicated.

Potential bidders are recommended to view, inspect, and research the auction vehicle's information before bidding.
Inspections are by appointment only. The seller recommends that auction winners tow the vehicles to a certified mechanic before driving on roadways. The majority of auction vehicles are court-ordered forfeitures; therefore, the vehicles' title history/status is unknown to the seller. It is unknown if the vehicles or auction items were working at the time of seizure.
Auction winners of vehicles WITHOUT a title will be presented with a copy of the TNDOS (Tennessee Department of Safety) forfeiture court order and a notarized bill of sale. Vehicles listed as (HAS TITLE) were titled/utilized by the seller in some capacity. It is suggested that all potential buyers check with their state's Department of Motor Vehicles before bidding to ensure a court order and bill of sale are sufficient for titling and registration purposes. The buyer is responsible for titling the vehicle in their residing county/state within 90 days of the close of the auction/bill of sale issuance.

description:
Vintage Calligraphy & Writing Collectible Set
Mixed Media Desk Set with Display Box
Wood, Glass, Metal, and Paper, 11 x 8 x 3 Inches
This comprehensive vintage writing and philatelic collection is housed in a decorative black wooden chest with a patterned interior lid. The set features classical tools for traditional correspondence, including both hand-blown glass and carved wooden dip pens, alongside an ornamental magnifying glass and a curated selection of mid-20th-century American postage stamps. Such sets were characteristic elements of personal stationery desks, appealing to calligraphy practitioners and historical ephemera collectors.
Hand-blown twisted glass dip pen and turned wooden pen handle with internal metal nib holder
11 assorted metal pen nibs in various sizes for calligraphy and fine writing
Vintage-style magnifying glass featuring an ornate, relief-patterned metal handle
6 vintage US postage stamps including 1949 Puerto Rico Inauguration (3c) and Noah Webster (4c) issues
Hinged black wooden box with dedicated storage compartments and a decorative patterned underside lid
Condition:
The wooden box shows light exterior shelf wear and surface dust accumulation. The glass pen is intact with no visible chips to the spiral writing tip; includes a small protective sleeve. The wooden pen handle shows significant surface patina, staining, and finish wear consistent with age. Metal nibs show varying degrees of surface oxidation. Stamps are in used/mixed condition; one Noah Webster stamp has a visible tear and several show adhesive residue or hinging marks. Magnifying glass lens is clear with minor tarnishing to the metal frame.
***Condition Disclaimer***
This is a USED item donated to Goodwill Easter Seals of the Miami Valley.
Please see images for further detail and ask any questions you may have before making a bid.
Note: Any testing of electronics for power and/or functionality will be mentioned within the listing above ONLY if applicable.
In some instances we may not have the necessary equipment to test certain electronics therefore these will be auctioned off AS-IS with no refunds.

description:
Assorted Crystal Cluster Lot
Natural and Treated Specimens
Total Weight: 2 lbs
This curated lot features three distinct mineral specimens, showcasing natural geological formations and artisanal color enhancements. The set includes a substantial amethyst geode slice, displaying a dense concentration of deep purple crystalline structures within a rocky matrix. Accompanying this are two aura quartz clusters-one in vibrant golden-yellow and the other in rich magenta-red-each treated with a metallic vapor process to produce a striking iridescent, prismatic luster across the crystal terminations.
Natural purple crystalline geode slice with deep violet terminations
Two iridescent treated quartz-style clusters with brilliant metallic finishes
Three-piece specimen lot ideal for decor, collection, or display
Diverse textures and colors ranging from earthy to prismatic
Condition:
Very good pre-owned condition. Stones exhibit natural terminations and textures inherent to mineral specimens. The purple crystals are intact with vibrant saturation. The iridescent coatings on the quartz clusters show consistent coverage and luster. No significant damage or repairs observed beyond natural geological variations.

description: This lot includes 9 natural mineral specimens primarily composed of selenite, a crystalline form of gypsum. The pieces range in translucency from translucent to transparent and exhibit a pearly luster. Most specimens are colorless or white, with one showing a light tan hue. These selenite specimens are suitable for mineral collectors, metaphysical applications, or educational purposes.

description:
Orthoceras Fossil Specimen Polished Nautiloid Cephalopod Shell Display
This fossil specimen features two Orthoceras fossils embedded in a dark gray to black matrix rock. Orthoceras is an extinct genus of nautiloid cephalopod characterized by long, tapered, conical shells with visible internal chamber lines. The matrix rock is rough and unpolished on the back and sides, while the fossilized shells on the front are polished to a glossy finish, highlighting their natural details and structure. The piece is in excellent natural condition with no visible repairs, suitable for fossil collectors or natural history displays.

description:

The set features a purple amethyst, a mostly white quartz, a light yellowish citrine-like stone, and two speckled granite or similar igneous rocks. Each piece is unpolished and irregularly shaped, ranging from approximately 1 to 2 inches in size. All specimens are in natural, unmodified condition with no visible brand or model markings. Suitable for collectors or educational use.

Measurements are approximates. Reserve prices do not reflect an appraisal value. We offer a three-day return policy on items with a major listing discrepancy. After three days of receipt, all sales are final.

Damage: Contact Goodwill2Go immediately in the event your items were damaged during shipping. Issues are resolved on a case-by-case basis.

Beautiful mixed lot of stones, crystals, and fossils ready for crafting, collecting, or display.
