shipping.policy:
******Effective May 5th, 2025 Combinations orders will be limited to a maximum of 5 items. If you have any questions or concerns, please let us know.*******
Shipping via FedEx:
All items and orders ship FedEx Ground.
FedEx shipping weight reflects the dimensional shipping charge for the final package size and the weight of the item being shipped. Orders posted on weekends ship within five business days starting the following Monday. We reserve the right to request signatures for any order.
Local Pick Up
:
Local pickup is not currently offered at our warehouse or any other store.
Combined Shipping:
Items may only be combined to save on shipping charges if:
The auctions close within 7 days of each other and are safe to ship in one box.
Do not exceed 20 lbs.weight
Combined items must be paid for on the same order.
No more than 5 Items may be combined into one order
Once paid for, items may not be combined.
Individual paid orders will ship individually and
do not
qualify for a combined shipping discount once paid.
Important: there is a limit to combined items based on size or weight. All items cannot be combined. A customer may select to combine items at checkout. If the dimensional weights or ship weights of items exceed 20 lbs, then no further items may be combined with the shipment.
Large or Fragile items, artwork, and electronics are sold as NO COMBINED SHIPPING and cannot typically be combined with other items.
Once a combined shipping charge has been calculated for an order, no additional items or recalculations are available. We reserve the right to deny any combination of items. Shipping charges are determined by the
dimensional box weight
and size of the item. All items requiring a shipping container of 36 inches or larger incur an oversize shipping charge.
Handling charges are as follows: $5 to $10 for oversize, instruments, or fragile items that are large or a set. All items will be shipped as listed and will not be dismantled for any reason. Shipping charges are set at the weight of the item plus packaging and are based upon our contracted carrier costs. Some items will receive dimensional surcharges and will result in a higher charge as the carriers charge by size of the package in addition to weight.

description:
Natural Agate Geode
Polished Stone Bookends Pair
Natural Agate, Made in Brazil
4" Tall
Unsigned
This pair of natural agate geode bookends showcases the geological beauty of Brazilian stone. Each piece features a highly polished face revealing intricate banding patterns and macrocrystalline quartz interiors that capture and reflect light. The exterior retains the natural, rugged stone rind, providing a striking textural contrast between the raw earth and the refined, glossy display surfaces.
Unique natural banding and crystalline structures characteristic of Brazilian agate
Weight and density provide stable support for book collections or library displays
Original "Made in Brazil" label remains attached to the stone surface
Natural earth tones integrate seamlessly with Mid-Century Modern or Bohemian decor
Condition:
Very good condition overall with average wear. As is common with natural stone specimens, both pieces exhibit some small chips along the edges and rinds. The polished surfaces show minimal age-appropriate wear, and the structural integrity remains sound.
***Condition Disclaimer***
This is a USED item donated to Goodwill of Eastern Kansas & Western Missouri.
All of our items are donations that have been previously owned. They are in used condition and will contain unseen flaws and/or imperfections in addition to the information listed here. Items are sold with all faults, whether or not immediately apparent.  We do not claim to be experts or appraisers of any items listed on ShopGoodwill. We will miss some details for which an interested bidder would know to look.  Please keep this in mind when shopping with us and ask all questions prior to placing a bid.
Note: Any testing of electronics for power and/or functionality will be mentioned within the listing above ONLY if applicable. In some instances we may not have the necessary equipment to test certain electronics therefore these will be auctioned off AS-IS with no refunds.

This striking natural agate geode specimen features a masterfully polished face that reveals intricate concentric banding in shades of teal, seafoam green, and deep cerulean. description:
Product Overview:
This listing features a mixed lot of assorted mineral and crystal specimens in natural, unpolished condition. The assortment includes rough stones, geodes with visible crystal interiors, a clear cylindrical mineral, a blue-green crystal, various quartz varieties, and other unique mineral formations. The specimens display a range of colors including earthy browns, grays, purples, and greens, with natural crystal growth, banding, and geode structures.

Specifications:
- Condition: Natural, unpolished specimens with some rough edges and minor chips
- Types: Includes geodes, quartz varieties, clear cylindrical mineral (likely selenite), blue-green crystal (potentially amazonite), and other mineral formations
- Color Range: Earthy browns, grays, purples, greens
- Features: Visible crystal interiors, natural crystal growth, banding patterns, geode structures

Additional Information:
- No brand or labeling provided
- Specimens are raw and unaltered
- Suitable for collectors and educational purposes

: Explore the fascinating world of geology with this premium collection of natural stones and crystals, perfect for education, study, or display. This set includes an array of tumbled gemstones, polished fossil stones, unique geode candle holders (one amethyst), and natural minerals, each selected for its eye-catching colors, patterns, and textures. Individual items include fossil coral stones, polished river rocks, a hand-carved gemstone dodecahedron, natural seashells, and various tumbled crystal varieties such as quartz, jasper, and agate. The geode candleholders make striking decorative pieces and conversation starters. Ideal for classrooms, collectors, or home decor enthusiasts, these specimens highlight the beauty and diversity of Earth's natural treasures. Every piece in this assortment has been carefully chosen for authenticity and quality, ensuring a unique addition to your collection. Description:
Add a touch of historic charm to your decor or collection with this genuine Hemingray-42 glass insulator in striking aqua blue. Renowned for their iconic craftsmanship and durability, Hemingray insulators were essential on telephone and telegraph lines in the early-to-mid-20th century. This piece features beautiful embossed branding, a thick glass body, and a delightful beaded rim detail, making it both visually attractive and functional. Whether displayed as a standalone accent, repurposed for creative DIY projects, or included in a larger antique glass collection, this insulator offers lasting appeal and nostalgia. Own a slice of industrial history, manufactured in the USA and sure to impress both collectors and design enthusiasts alike. Buy confidently, knowing this is an authentic vintage piece, ideal for gifting or personal enjoyment.
